description: A number passes sentence recognition exactly when it is the code of a sentence of the specified language.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.sentence_recognition_iff.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (S : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.EffectiveSignature L) (e : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.isSentence S e = true ↔
    ∃ a, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.sentenceCode S a = e
